# testing_x_pagination_offset_limits (Resource)

XPaginationOffsetLimits Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_x_pagination_offset_limits" "my_xpaginationoffsetlimits" {
  string_request = "...my_string_request..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `string_request` (String) Configurable string for request, to ensure other configurable
attributes are not affected by pagination having input attributes
removed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique identifier for the resource
- `results` (List of String)
